name: ITER, Cadarache, France (35-nation collaboration)
description: tokamak designed for 500 MW fusion power (ten times the input heating); European Council approved EUR 5.61 bn EU funding to 2027 (Feb 2021); first plasma had been expected December 2025 before the 2024 schedule re-baseline added years and about EUR 5 bn; NIF (US) demonstrated fusion ignition December 2022

sources.note: S&P Global, 22 Feb 2021 (EUR 5.61 bn to 2027; first plasma then expected Dec 2025, full operation 2035); 2024 re-baseline reported Jul 2024; read 2026-10-28
